title: Citus: per-node Vault PKI cert rotation (PG reload, etcd restart)
description: Runs `nexus cert-rotate citus`: re-issues a fresh leaf from pki_int/issue/citus-server on every node via its own Vault Agent token, runs nexus-citus-tls-split.sh, and applies — PG nodes RELOAD (SIGHUP, no failover) and etcd nodes RESTART. Order: etcd -> worker replicas -> worker leaders -> coord replica -> coord leader LAST.

observe.what: 9 rows old->new serial, 0 errors; cluster stays green (PG reloaded so no leader is demoted)
JSON CertRotationResult: 9 rotatedNodes, each with a new serial_number, error=null

whatProves: CitusAdapter.RotateCertAsync re-issues per-host certs via the node Agent token + nexus-citus-tls-split.sh; PG nodes reload (no failover), etcd restarts; coordinator leader last so the write endpoint reloads only after the rest are healthy.
